chunks: My father and Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may God be pleased with them) narrated, saying: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem narrated from his father, from Sa'd ibn Sa'd, who said: I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him)
about the visiting of Fatima, daughter of Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), so he said: Whoever visits her, for him is Paradise.

key_terms.فَاطِمَة بِنْت مُوسَى: Fatima, daughter of Imam Musa al-Kazim

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the shrine of Fatima bint Musa (a.s.)?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this hadith establishes the shrine of Fatima bint Musa (al-Naqi) in Qum as a significant site of pilgrimage, linking the veneration of the Imams' female descendants directly to the promise of Paradise. This narration underscores the Shia tradition of *Ziyarat* not merely as a physical visit but as a means of spiritual connection and intercession through the progeny of the Prophet.
